#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hermes Google domain-wide-delegation (DWD) connector.

- The service-account key lives ONLY in 1Password (vault "Hermes", item
  "Google Service Account"). It is fetched per process via the op CLI into
  memory and never written to disk.
- Impersonation is restricted to ALLOWED_SUBJECTS below (Google itself would
  allow any amforge.com user; this allowlist is the Hermes-side limit).
- Every token mint and API call is appended to AUDIT_LOG (metadata only, no
  message content, no secrets).
- This module currently exposes READ operations only. Send/delete/modify are
  intentionally not implemented here; they require an explicit user "send"
  instruction and a separate reviewed code path.
- Draft removal: ONLY via gmail_trash_draft(), which trashes (never hard-deletes)
  a single draft that this same Hermes session created (see DRAFT_LEDGER).
  Never call the Gmail drafts DELETE endpoint from ad-hoc code.

Run from a directory other than /root (a stray /root/inspect.py shadows the
stdlib module there).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import padding

OP_TOKEN_FILE = Path("/root/.config/amforge/op_sa_token")
OP_VAULT = "Hermes"
OP_ITEM_ID = "a3vszgwqaf3an2uigjrdqooc5y"  # "Google Service Account" (Document)
AUDIT_LOG = Path("/root/.hermes/google-workspace/dwd_audit.log")

# Hermes-side impersonation allowlist. Anything else is refused.
# Dan 2026-11-02: board Do it may work in Al's and Becki's own accounts (their cards), "but no one else".
ALLOWED_SUBJECTS = {"dwhaley@amforge.com", "amendez@amforge.com", "becki@amforge.com"}
# Dan 2026-11-09 (#af-ops thread 1794237768.526349): "you can act on all GHI mailboxes". Any @ghi.gl
# address is delegable (ghi.gl Admin DWD entry for this SA's client ID). Who may ask is gated in
# af_policy.check_ghi_mailbox (Slack: Dan, Becki, Al only).
ALLOWED_DOMAINS = {"ghi.gl"}


# Dan 2026-11-12 (#af-ai thread 1794517563.537949): "authenticate Neil to be able to create documents under
# his account". Drive/Docs/Sheets ONLY (the full drive scope; Gmail and Calendar refused for these subjects).
# Deliberately NOT in ALLOWED_SUBJECTS, so the board's ownerbox rule (Do it mailbox choice) is unchanged.
# Who may ask from Slack: the account owner or Dan (af_policy.check_docs_only_subject).
DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS = {"ncohn@amforge.com"}


# Dan 2026-11-23: "allow our system to read Drive, Docs, email and calendar for the purpose of informing our overall
# systems. The individuals themselves are not allowed broad visibility of other people's emails and calendars and so
# forth, except to the extent that we specify in the interface."
# So: READ ONLY, and only for declared system jobs (e.g. the meetings importer), never for an agent session someone is
# driving (Slack, board Do it/prompts, cron agents). af_policy.check_system_read_subject enforces who; every write
# helper below refuses these subjects (Neil keeps his Drive/Docs writes from DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS).
# Deliberately NOT in ALLOWED_SUBJECTS, so the board's ownerbox rule (Do it mailbox choice) is unchanged.
import sys as _sys0
if "/root/.hermes/hooks" not in _sys0.path:
    _sys0.path.insert(0, "/root/.hermes/hooks")
from af_policy import SYSTEM_READ_SUBJECTS  # noqa: E402  (one list, defined with its gate)


def _refuse_system_write(subject: str, action: str, drive: bool = False):
    s = (subject or "").lower().strip()
    if s in SYSTEM_READ_SUBJECTS and not (drive and s in DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS):
        _audit("refused", subject=s, action=action, reason="system-read subject: writes are not allowed")
        raise Refused(f"{s} is delegated to the system for reading only; {action} refused")
    if s in SYSTEM_READ_SUBJECTS:
        _audit("allowed", subject=s, action=action, reason="Drive write under the owner's Docs-only grant")


def subject_allowed(subject: str) -> bool:
    s = (subject or "").lower().strip()
    return (s in ALLOWED_SUBJECTS or s in DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS or s in SYSTEM_READ_SUBJECTS
            or ("@" in s and s.rsplit("@", 1)[1] in ALLOWED_DOMAINS))

# DWD only mints tokens for the EXACT scope strings authorized in Admin
# (a narrower scope like gmail.readonly is refused unless also listed there).
# These are the authorized (full) scopes; this module's code paths are still
# read-only — write capability is gated by code, not by the scope string.
SCOPES_READ = {
    "gmail": "https://mail.google.com/",
    "calendar": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar",
    "drive": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive",
}

_key_cache: dict | None = None
_tok_cache: dict[tuple, tuple[str, float]] = {}


class Refused(Exception):
    pass


def _audit(event: str, **kw):
    AUDIT_LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rec = {"ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "event": event,
           "requester": os.environ.get("HERMES_REQUESTER", "cli-session"), **kw}
    fd = os.open(AUDIT_LOG, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")


def _load_key() -> dict:
    global _key_cache
    if _key_cache is None:
        tok = OP_TOKEN_FILE.read_text().strip()
        env = {"PATH": os.environ.get("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin"), "HOME": "/root",
               "OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN": tok}
        r = subprocess.run(["op", "document", "get", OP_ITEM_ID, "--vault", OP_VAULT],
                           env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        del tok, env
        if r.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError("1Password fetch failed: " + r.stderr.decode()[:200])
        k = json.loads(r.stdout)
        if k.get("type") != "service_account":
            raise RuntimeError("1Password item is not a service-account key")
        _key_cache = k
    return _key_cache


def _b64(b: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b"=").decode()


def access_token(subject: str, scopes: list[str], *, read_only: bool = False) -> str:
    subject = subject.lower().strip()
    if not subject_allowed(subject):
        _audit("refused", subject=subject, reason="subject not in allowlist")
        raise Refused(f"impersonation of {subject} is not allowed")
    # Dan 2026-11-06: "block direct inquiries into my email and other things". From Slack, acting as
    # dwhaley@ (mail, calendar, Drive) is allowed only when Dan is the one asking. Fails closed.
    # Dan 2026-11-09: @ghi.gl mailboxes only when Dan, Becki or Al is asking. Fails closed.
    try:
        import sys as _sys
        if "/root/.hermes/hooks" not in _sys.path:
            _sys.path.insert(0, "/root/.hermes/hooks")
        import af_policy
        af_policy.check_dan_mailbox(subject)
        af_policy.check_ghi_mailbox(subject)
        bad = [s for s in scopes if s != SCOPES_READ["drive"]]
        if subject in DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS and not bad:
            af_policy.check_docs_only_subject(subject)          # Neil's own Drive/Docs, as before
        elif subject in SYSTEM_READ_SUBJECTS:
            # Review 2026-11-23: read-only by default, not by a list of refused writes. A token for these accounts is
            # handed out only to a caller that declares it will only read (dwd.get, the meetings importer's GETs).
            if not read_only:
                raise Refused(f"{subject} is delegated to the system for reading only; ask with read_only=True")
            af_policy.check_system_read_subject(subject)        # system jobs only (their own systemd unit)
        elif subject in DOCS_ONLY_SUBJECTS:
            raise Refused(f"{subject} is delegated for Drive/Docs/Sheets only; refused scopes: {bad}")
    except Exception as exc:
        _audit("refused", subject=subject, reason="af_policy: " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)[:200])
        raise Refused(str(exc))
    ck = (subject, tuple(sorted(scopes)))
    hit = _tok_cache.get(ck)
    if hit and hit[1] - 60 > time.time():
        return hit[0]
    k = _load_key()
    now = int(time.time())
    header = {"alg": "RS256", "typ": "JWT", "kid": k["private_key_id"]}
    claims = {"iss": k["client_email"], "sub": subject, "scope": " ".join(scopes),
              "aud": k["token_uri"], "iat": now, "exp": now + 3600}
    signing_input = f"{_b64(json.dumps(header).encode())}.{_b64(json.dumps(claims).encode())}".encode()
    pk = serialization.load_pem_private_key(k["private_key"].encode(), password=None)
    sig = pk.sign(signing_input, padding.PKCS1v15(), hashes.SHA256())
    assertion = signing_input.decode() + "." + _b64(sig)
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer",
                                   "assertion": assertion}).encode()
    try:
        resp = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(k["token_uri"], data, timeout=30))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode()[:300]
        _audit("token_error", subject=subject, scopes=scopes, status=e.code, detail=body)
        raise RuntimeError(f"token mint failed ({e.code}): {body}")
    _audit("token_minted", subject=subject, scopes=scopes)
    _tok_cache[ck] = (resp["access_token"], time.time() + int(resp.get("expires_in", 3600)))
    return resp["access_token"]


def get(subject: str, service: str, url: str, action: str, target: str = "") -> dict:
    tok = access_token(subject, [SCOPES_READ[service]], read_only=True)   # GET only, below
    _audit("api_read", subject=subject, service=service, action=action, target=target[:200])
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok})
    try:
        return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{service} API {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")


# ---------------- Gmail helpers (read-only) ----------------
G = "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me"


def gmail_search(subject: str, q: str, n: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
    r = get(subject, "gmail", f"{G}/messages?maxResults={n}&q=" + urllib.parse.quote(q), "gmail.search", q)
    out = []
    for m in r.get("messages", []):
        md = get(subject, "gmail", f"{G}/messages/{m['id']}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From"
                 "&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Cc&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=Date",
                 "gmail.metadata", m["id"])
        h = {x["name"]: x["value"] for x in md["payload"]["headers"]}
        out.append({"id": m["id"], "threadId": md["threadId"], "date": h.get("Date", ""),
                    "from": h.get("From", ""), "to": h.get("To", ""), "cc": h.get("Cc", ""),
                    "subject": h.get("Subject", ""), "snippet": md.get("snippet", ""),
                    "labels": md.get("labelIds", [])})
    return out


def _walk_parts(p, texts, atts):
    mt = p.get("mimeType", "")
    if p.get("filename"):
        atts.append({"filename": p["filename"], "mimeType": mt, "size": p.get("body", {}).get("size"),
                     "attachmentId": p.get("body", {}).get("attachmentId")})
    elif mt == "text/plain" and p.get("body", {}).get("data"):
        texts.append(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p["body"]["data"]).decode("utf-8", "ignore"))
    for c in p.get("parts", []) or []:
        _walk_parts(c, texts, atts)


def gmail_thread(subject: str, thread_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    t = get(subject, "gmail", f"{G}/threads/{thread_id}?format=full", "gmail.thread", thread_id)
    msgs = []
    for m in t.get("messages", []):
        h = {x["name"]: x["value"] for x in m["payload"]["headers"]}
        texts, atts = [], []
        _walk_parts(m["payload"], texts, atts)
        msgs.append({"id": m["id"], "date": h.get("Date", ""), "from": h.get("From", ""),
                     "to": h.get("To", ""), "cc": h.get("Cc", ""), "subject": h.get("Subject", ""),
                     "body": "\n".join(texts), "attachments": atts})
    return msgs


# ---------------- Gmail DRAFT creation (write, reversible; never sends) ----------------
def gmail_create_draft(subject: str, *, to: list[str], cc: list[str], subj: str, body: str,
                       thread_id: str | None = None, in_reply_to: str | None = None,
                       attachments: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict:
    """Create a Gmail DRAFT in `subject`'s mailbox. Does NOT send.
    attachments: list of (local_path, filename_to_show)."""
    _refuse_system_write(subject, "gmail.draft.create")
    from email.message import EmailMessage
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["To"] = ", ".join(to)
    if cc:
        msg["Cc"] = ", ".join(cc)
    msg["Subject"] = subj
    if in_reply_to:
        msg["In-Reply-To"] = in_reply_to
        msg["References"] = in_reply_to
    msg.set_content(body)
    import mimetypes
    for path, name in attachments or []:
        mt = mimetypes.guess_type(name)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
        maintype, subtype = mt.split("/", 1)
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            msg.add_attachment(f.read(), maintype=maintype, subtype=subtype, filename=name)
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(msg.as_bytes()).decode()
    payload = {"message": {"raw": raw}}
    if thread_id:
        payload["message"]["threadId"] = thread_id
    tok = access_token(subject, [SCOPES_READ["gmail"]])
    _audit("gmail.draft.create", subject=subject, to=to, cc=cc, subj=subj[:150],
           thread=thread_id or "", attachments=[n for _, n in attachments or []])
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{G}/drafts", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST",
                                 headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok, "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        res = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"gmail draft create {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")
    _ledger_add(subject, res["id"], res.get("message", {}).get("id", ""), to, subj)
    return res


# ---------------- Draft cleanup guard (added 2026-10-01 after an incident) ----------------
# Incident: an ad-hoc cleanup called DELETE /drafts/{id} for every draft matching a recipient
# query, permanently destroying 5 drafts Hermes had not created. Rules enforced here:
#   1. Only drafts recorded in DRAFT_LEDGER as created by THIS Hermes session can be removed.
#   2. Removal is by exact draft id only (no query/recipient-based bulk removal).
#   3. Removal TRASHES the underlying message (recoverable for 30 days); it never hard-deletes.
# Never call the Gmail drafts DELETE endpoint directly from ad-hoc code; use gmail_trash_draft.
DRAFT_LEDGER = Path("/root/.hermes/google-workspace/state/draft_ledger.jsonl")


def _session_id() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("HERMES_SESSION_ID", "")


def _ledger_add(subject: str, draft_id: str, message_id: str, to, subj: str):
    DRAFT_LEDGER.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rec = {"ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "session": _session_id(),
           "subject": subject, "draft_id": draft_id, "message_id": message_id,
           "to": to, "subj": subj[:150]}
    fd = os.open(DRAFT_LEDGER, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")


def _ledger_lookup(subject: str, draft_id: str) -> dict | None:
    if not DRAFT_LEDGER.exists():
        return None
    hit = None
    for line in DRAFT_LEDGER.read_text().splitlines():
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if r.get("draft_id") == draft_id and r.get("subject") == subject:
            hit = r
    return hit


def gmail_trash_draft(subject: str, draft_id: str) -> dict:
    """Move ONE Hermes-created draft to Trash (recoverable). Refuses anything else."""
    _refuse_system_write(subject, "gmail.draft.trash")
    rec = _ledger_lookup(subject, draft_id)
    sid = _session_id()
    if not rec:
        _audit("refused", subject=subject, action="gmail.draft.trash", draft_id=draft_id,
               reason="draft not created by Hermes (not in ledger)")
        raise Refused(f"draft {draft_id} was not created by Hermes; refusing to remove it")
    if not sid or rec.get("session") != sid:
        _audit("refused", subject=subject, action="gmail.draft.trash", draft_id=draft_id,
               reason="draft created in a different session")
        raise Refused(f"draft {draft_id} was created in another session; ask the user to remove it")
    tok = access_token(subject, [SCOPES_READ["gmail"]])
    H = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok}
    d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(f"{G}/drafts/{draft_id}?format=minimal",
                                                                 headers=H), timeout=60))
    mid = d["message"]["id"]
    _audit("gmail.draft.trash", subject=subject, draft_id=draft_id, message_id=mid, subj=rec.get("subj", ""))
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{G}/messages/{mid}/trash", data=b"", method="POST", headers=H)
    return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))


# ---------------- Calendar event creation (write) ----------------
def calendar_create_event(subject: str, *, summary: str, start: str, end: str, tz: str,
                          attendees: list[str], description: str = "", with_meet: bool = True,
                          send_updates: str = "none", visibility: str = "default") -> dict:
    """Create an event on `subject`'s primary calendar. send_updates: none|externalOnly|all.
    Default 'none' = no invitation emails go out (a separate explicit step sends them)."""
    _refuse_system_write(subject, "calendar.event.create")
    import uuid
    ev = {"summary": summary, "description": description, "visibility": visibility,
          "start": {"dateTime": start, "timeZone": tz}, "end": {"dateTime": end, "timeZone": tz},
          "attendees": [{"email": a} for a in attendees], "guestsCanSeeOtherGuests": True}
    if with_meet:
        ev["conferenceData"] = {"createRequest": {"requestId": uuid.uuid4().hex,
                                                  "conferenceSolutionKey": {"type": "hangoutsMeet"}}}
    tok = access_token(subject, [SCOPES_READ["calendar"]])
    _audit("calendar.event.create", subject=subject, summary=summary[:150], start=start,
           attendees=attendees, send_updates=send_updates)
    url = ("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?conferenceDataVersion=1"
           f"&sendUpdates={send_updates}")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(ev).encode(), method="POST",
                                 headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok, "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"calendar create {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")


def calendar_send_invites(subject: str, event_id: str) -> dict:
    """Send invitations for an event created with send_updates='none'.
    Removes guests silently, then re-adds them with sendUpdates=all so each
    receives a real invitation (a no-op PATCH does not reliably notify)."""
    _refuse_system_write(subject, "calendar.invites.send")
    tok = access_token(subject, [SCOPES_READ["calendar"]])
    base = f"https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events/{event_id}"
    hdr = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    ev = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base, headers=hdr), timeout=60))
    guests = [{"email": a["email"]} for a in ev.get("attendees", []) if not a.get("self")]
    _audit("calendar.invites.send", subject=subject, event_id=event_id, attendees=[g["email"] for g in guests])

    def _patch(body, send):
        r = urllib.request.Request(f"{base}?sendUpdates={send}&conferenceDataVersion=1",
                                   data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="PATCH", headers=hdr)
        try:
            return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"calendar patch {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")
    _patch({"attendees": []}, "none")
    return _patch({"attendees": guests}, "all")


# ---------------- Drive sharing (write) ----------------
def drive_share(subject: str, file_id: str, emails: list[str], role: str = "writer",
                notify: bool = False) -> list[dict]:
    """Share a Drive file with specific people (never 'anyone'/domain links)."""
    _refuse_system_write(subject, "drive.share", drive=True)
    import urllib.request as _u
    tok = access_token(subject, ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive"])
    out = []
    for e in emails:
        body = json.dumps({"type": "user", "role": role, "emailAddress": e}).encode()
        url = (f"https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{file_id}/permissions"
               f"?sendNotificationEmail={'true' if notify else 'false'}&supportsAllDrives=true"
               f"&fields=id,emailAddress,role")
        req = _u.Request(url, data=body, method="POST",
                         headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok, "Content-Type": "application/json"})
        out.append(json.load(_u.urlopen(req, timeout=60)))
    _audit("drive.share", subject=subject, file_id=file_id, emails=emails, role=role, notify=notify)
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("cmd", choices=["search", "thread", "whoami"])
    ap.add_argument("arg", nargs="?", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--as", dest="subject", default="dwhaley@amforge.com")
    ap.add_argument("-n", type=int, default=20)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "whoami":
        print(json.dumps(get(a.subject, "gmail", f"{G}/profile", "gmail.profile"), indent=1))
    elif a.cmd == "search":
        print(json.dumps(gmail_search(a.subject, a.arg, a.n), indent=1))
    else:
        print(json.dumps(gmail_thread(a.subject, a.arg), indent=1))
